name: taom_npccharacter
description: All NPCCharacter definitions (troops, notables, lords, heroes, wanderers, companions, education templates). applies_to MUST list every file that defines <NPCCharacter> so duplicate-id + enum checks are complete -- add new NPC-def files here (Codex review 2026-05-30 found wanderers/companions/education uncovered). _refs_note: Item. / NPCCharacter. / Culture. refs in these files are checked by the global cross-reference sweep in taom_schema.py (REF_KINDS). upgrade_target ids use the NPCCharacter. prefix; equipment ids use Item.; the culture attribute uses Culture.
